article.headline: Tillery scores 29 as Charlotte knocks off Indiana State 78-70
article.description: — Keyshuan Tillery's 29 points helped Charlotte defeat Indiana State 78-70 on Monday.
article.linkText: Tillery scores 29 as Charlotte knocks off Indiana State 78-70
article.story: TERRE HAUTE, Ind. -- — Keyshuan Tillery's 29 points helped Charlotte defeat Indiana State 78-70 on Monday. Tillery shot 9 of 15 from the field, including 7 for 10 from 3-point range, and went 4 for 4 from the line for the 49ers. Dorian Finister scored 11 points and added 10 rebounds and five assists. Karmani Gregory led the Sycamores in scoring, finishing with 29 points and eight assists. Indiana State also got 15 points and two steals from Maguire Mitchell, and Duce Paschal had nine points. Up next Charlotte: host Georgia State on Thursday. Indiana State: visits Ball State on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
